body.message:
We understand your concern; however, completing the check-in form is a mandatory requirement as part of the check-in process.

Please note that there will be no staff available at the building to assist with completing the form upon arrival. Once the check-in form has been submitted, we will be able to register your reservation with the building management and ensure a smooth check-in experience.

Therefore, we kindly request that you complete the check-in form prior to your arrival to avoid any inconvenience or delays during the check-in process.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
